builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Volibear: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (3,243 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 54.3% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A pursuing melee bruiser who stuns to set up a delayed shield zone and stays on one marked target for healing. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Dusk and Dawn → Navori Flickerblade → Spirit Visage. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, Randuin's Omen.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Dusk and Dawn → Navori Flickerblade → Spirit Visage, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Dusk and Dawn → Navori Flickerblade → Spirit Visage) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 54.3% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Dusk and Dawn → Navori Flickerblade → Spirit Visage.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining [175 / 350 / 525] Health and [50] Attack Range for the next [12] seconds.

Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for [2 / 3 / 4] seconds and dealing [300 / 500 / 700 + (1.25) × AP + (2.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by [50]%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer [300 / 500 / 700 + (1.25) × AP + (2.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Volibear gains [0.12 / 0.155 / 0.19 / 0.225 / 0.26] Move Speed, doubled to [0.24 / 0.31 / 0.38 / 0.45 / 0.52] towards enemy champions for the next [4] seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (1) × AD + (1.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Stuns the target for [1] second.

Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.

Volibear gains [0.05 + (0.0004) × AP] Attack Speed for [6] seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=11, perLevel=1, changes=[{"mLevel": 4, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.45) × AP + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.

Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing [5 / 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 + (1.1) × AD + (0.06) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage and marking them for [8] seconds.

If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to [(5 / 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 + (1.1) × AD + (0.06) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × ((1.5 + (0.0025) × AD[statFormula=2]))] and Volibear restores [20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80] plus [0.08 / 0.11 / 0.14 / 0.17 / 0.2] missing Health.

Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing [80 / 110 / 140 / 170 / 200 + (0.7) × AP] plus [(0.11 / 0.12 / 0.13 / 0.14 / 0.15) × 100]% max Health magic damage and Slowing by [40]% for [2] seconds.

If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a [(0.75) × AP] plus [14]% max Health Shield for [3] seconds.

builds.name: Lightning AP ramp
builds.summary: Turn AP into passive attack cadence as well as lightning damage.
builds.goal: Turn AP into passive attack cadence as well as lightning damage.
builds.hypothesis: Each passive stack grants attack speed with an AP term, up to five stacks, then attacks add AP-scaled chain lightning. Nashor and Rageblade test the attack phase; E has an AP/health shield for staying close, and Riftmaker rewards extended contact. Terminus supports mixed physical/magic attacks after ramp.
testPlan: Required state: Five earned passive stacks and attack access; Rageblade/Terminus ramps recorded separately.
Count passive stacks, attack intervals and lightning packets before and after five stacks, with phantom hits isolated.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Stacks expire during kiting or low durability prevents reaching full attack ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Chain lightning does not prove extra targets receive Nashor or every on-hit effect.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Magic matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Volibear: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A pursuing melee bruiser who stuns to set up a delayed shield zone and stays on one marked target for healing. Keep the same W-marked target for the healing recast, and land E's delayed shield. AP/attack speed may reward passive hits but cannot guarantee lightning chains or permanent W recovery. MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
builds.summary: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Volibear: Keep the same W-marked target for the healing recast, and land E's delayed shield. AP/attack speed may reward passive hits but cannot guarantee lightning chains or permanent W recovery.

Start with the early core (Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.

The route fails Volibear's stated kit question: Keep the same W-marked target for the healing recast, and land E's delayed shield. AP/attack speed may reward passive hits but cannot guarantee lightning chains or permanent W recovery.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.
Full cost 15,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Wounded mark revisit
builds.summary: Prioritize reaching a second W on the same marked target.
builds.goal: Prioritize reaching a second W on the same marked target.
builds.hypothesis: W's mark lasts eight seconds; recast gains a damage multiplier involving AD and heals missing health. Shojin basic haste and Trinity spell-followed attacks support repeat contact, Bloodmail supplies health-derived AD and Visage strengthens W healing/E shielding. Q stun buys time for the initial setup.
testPlan: Required state: Same target remains marked, current health/AD recorded and W returns before mark expiry.
Log first versus marked W damage/heal at matched missing health and changing AD; measure actual revisit time.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Target swapping forfeits the heal or crowd control denies the second cast.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The helper labeled Thundering Smash containing R text is not a second Q or R damage source.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Spear of Shojin, Trinity Force, Overlord's Bloodmail, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
